title: From greybox to playable art: an open-source AI workflow for Godot and Unity
author: No_Evening7694
selftext:
We’ve been building **Grey2Art**, an open-source Agent Skill that helps turn playable greyboxes into editable art prototypes in Godot or Unity.

It can work with Codex, Claude Code, etc. You choose the direction and review the results; the agent handles the production steps. The resulting scenes and assets remain editable, with support for local revisions and continuing interrupted tasks.

![video](p2mgrum7ibzh1 "Meet Grey2Art")

We’re looking for feedback from developers working on real projects.

Source, demos, and setup instructions: [github.com/hbzheng0942/grey2art](https://github.com/hbzheng0942/grey2art)
